title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
headline: LLM-Powered Subtask Planning Boosts Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation by Freezing Vision-Language Models
tldr: The authors freeze vision-language-action models and let an LLM agent plan subtask sequences in language. This approach reduces error compounding and allows robots to execute long-horizon manipulation chains more reliably.
significance: It demonstrates that LLM-driven subtask planning can overcome limitations of end-to-end VLA models in complex, multi-stage robotic tasks.

title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
headline: Q-Based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning: A Bayesian Approach to Preference Inference
tldr: Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL) introduces a Bayesian framework that infers reward functions from expert behavior using Q-functions. The method improves safety and alignment in AI by learning human preferences more efficiently.
significance: QVIRL offers a principled way to align AI systems with human values, enhancing both safety and performance.

title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
headline: Training Pixel-Space Diffusion Models to Rival Latent Counterparts: An Empirical Guide
tldr: This study presents a practical recipe for training pixel-space text-to-image diffusion models that match or surpass latent-space models. Through extensive experiments, the authors identify key architectural and training choices that yield state-of-the-art performance.
significance: It bridges the gap between pixel-space and latent-space diffusion, providing a reproducible framework for high-quality image generation.

title: Evaluating Beyond the Screen: Collective Assessment of AI-Generated Business Plans with Resource-Constrained Entrepreneurs
headline: Collective Assessment of AI-Generated Business Plans for Resource-Constrained Entrepreneurs in Emerging Markets
tldr: Entrepreneurs rely on generative AI for critical documents, but errors can jeopardize funding. This study explores collaborative evaluation methods beyond the screen to improve accuracy for resource-constrained users.
significance: The research offers a scalable framework for improving AI-generated business plan reliability, crucial for small business financing.

title: $τ_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
headline: τ0-VLA: Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with Adaptive Test-Time Computation for Long-Horizon Tasks
tldr: τ0-VLA introduces a hierarchical vision-language-action framework that allocates extra computation to challenging decisions, improving long-horizon robot manipulation. By leveraging a world model at test time, it dynamically balances speed and accuracy for complex tasks.
significance: This approach enables more reliable and efficient robot planning by adaptively investing computational resources where they matter most.

title: Simplicial Actions for Distributed Protocols
headline: Simplicial Action Models for Distributed Protocols: Advancing Modal Logic in Complex Systems
tldr: This paper extends the semantics of belief revision in simplicial complexes by integrating action models, enabling dynamic epistemic reasoning in distributed protocols. The authors demonstrate how these models capture protocol updates and provide a framework for analyzing knowledge evolution in multi-agent systems.
significance: By bridging simplicial semantics with action models, the work offers a novel tool for formal verification of distributed protocols, enhancing robustness and transparency.

title: Spectral Gaps of Hit-and-Run and Coordinate Hit-and-Run
headline: Spectral Gap Bounds for Hit-and-Run and Coordinate Hit-and-Run in Convex Bodies
tldr: The paper establishes a lower bound on the spectral gap of the Hit‑and‑Run algorithm in terms of the Poincaré constant of the target distribution over a convex body. It also extends the analysis to the Coordinate Hit‑and‑Run variant, yielding similar convergence guarantees.
significance: These results provide the first rigorous mixing time bounds for Hit‑and‑Run in high dimensions, improving our understanding of random walk sampling algorithms.

title: On the relations between several notions of symmetry for the second order linear differential equation
headline: Symmetry Correspondence in Second-Order Linear ODEs
tldr: The paper establishes explicit links between Lie point, vertical, and operator symmetries for second-order linear differential equations, and describes the Lie algebra of infinite symmetries.
significance: It unifies disparate symmetry concepts, facilitating deeper analysis of linear ODEs.

title: Size matters more than packing in bimodal colloidal gel compositions
headline: Particle Size Trumps Packing in Bimodal Colloidal Gels
tldr: Simulations of bimodal colloidal gels with a 1:2 size ratio show that increasing the proportion of large particles enhances gel strength more than changes in local packing density. The study highlights particle size as the dominant factor in determining mechanical properties of depletion gels.
significance: This work challenges the conventional focus on packing density, emphasizing particle size as the key design parameter for colloidal gel formulations.

title: Impression Share Prediction: An Offline Evaluation Task for Ranking Systems
headline: Predicting Impression Share: Offline Evaluation for Ranking System Effectiveness
tldr: Offline metrics often miss how ranking models shift impression distribution, potentially harming downstream outcomes. This paper proposes a method to predict impression share shifts, enabling better pre-deployment assessment.
significance: Accurately forecasting impression share changes allows practitioners to avoid costly online failures and align models with business goals.

title: Biophysics-informed deep operator learning for inverse problems with application to electrophysiological source reconstruction
headline: Deep Operator Learning Illuminates Neural Source Reconstruction from Noisy Brain Signals
tldr: By integrating biophysical constraints into deep operator networks, researchers can more accurately recover hidden neural activity from indirect, noisy measurements. This approach improves the stability and speed of electrophysiological source reconstruction.
significance: It offers a robust, physics-informed framework that could enhance real-time brain mapping for clinical and research applications.

title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
headline: Data-Efficient Deep Learning Classifies Tumor Cell Phenotypes from Microfluidic Trajectories
tldr: The study presents a data‑efficient deep‑learning framework that interprets the kinematic trajectories of circulating tumor cells in microfluidic obstacle courses to classify phenotypes. By leveraging limited labeled data and explainable model components, it offers a rapid, label‑free diagnostic tool for metastatic potential assessment.
significance: This approach enables rapid, interpretable phenotyping of circulating tumor cells without labeling, potentially accelerating personalized cancer diagnostics.

title: Blazar Boosted Dark Matter in IceCube
headline: IceCube Probes Blazar-Boosted Dark Matter with 324 Blazar Sample
tldr: We evaluate IceCube's sensitivity to dark matter accelerated by blazar jets, modeling 324 blazars with inferred proton spectra. Our analysis shows that conservative dark matter spike profiles still allow detectable neutrino fluxes, setting new constraints on fermionic dark matter with vector mediators.
significance: This study links high-energy astrophysics and particle physics, offering a novel probe of dark matter interactions via blazar environments.

title: Forging Self-Funded Marketplaces among Strategic Agents
headline: Designing Incentive Mechanisms for Self-Funded Marketplaces Among Strategic Agents in Competitive Environments
tldr: We study how to design mechanisms that motivate agents to invest effort in a marketplace that they collectively fund. By modeling effort costs and revenues, we characterize conditions under which self-sustaining equilibria exist.
significance: This work provides foundational insights for building decentralized platforms where participants jointly finance and sustain economic activity.

title: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing
headline: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive, Practical, Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing Models
tldr: CPI-Bench introduces a comprehensive, practical, and intelligent benchmark designed to evaluate image editing models in real-world scenarios. It expands beyond single-image tasks, offering diverse coverage dimensions to better differentiate performance across advanced models.
significance: By providing a more realistic assessment framework, CPI-Bench accelerates the deployment of cutting-edge image editing technologies in practical applications.

title: Compressive Domains and a Bound for the Number of Components of the Fixed Locus of a Self-Map of the Berkovich Line
headline: Bound on Fixed Locus Components via Compressive Domains
tldr: We define compressive domains for rational maps on the Berkovich line, show they contain a classical fixed point, and use this to bound the number of connected components of the fixed locus.
significance: Provides a sharp upper bound on fixed locus components, advancing understanding of dynamics on nonarchimedean analytic spaces.

title: Decoding the Past: An Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Sex Attribution in Prehistoric Hand Stencils
headline: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Decodes Sex of Prehistoric Hand Stencil Artists
tldr: We present a deep learning framework that incorporates uncertainty estimation to classify the biological sex of artists who created Upper Paleolithic hand stencils, overcoming challenges like lack of ground truth and image degradation. The model leverages transfer learning from contemporary populations and outputs probabilistic predictions, offering a robust tool for archaeologists.
significance: This approach provides archaeologists with a statistically grounded method to infer gender roles in prehistoric societies, bridging a critical gap in cultural anthropology.

title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking
headline: Leveraging LLMs for Semantics-Aware Type-Checking and Improved Vulnerability Detection in Complex Codebases
tldr: Traditional static analysis relies on syntactic rules, missing semantic cues like variable names. This study introduces an LLM-augmented type-checker that captures semantic context, improving vulnerability detection accuracy.
significance: By integrating LLMs, the approach bridges the gap between syntax and semantics, enabling more precise security analysis.

title: Trust Without Boundaries: An Architectural Analysis of Satellite Flight Software
headline: Breaking the Trust Barrier: Analyzing Satellite Flight Software Architecture for Secure Operations
tldr: Onboard flight software is a critical security boundary in modern spacecraft. Our analysis of NASA's Core Flight Software reveals that treating components as trusted peers limits isolation and access control, exposing vulnerabilities.
significance: Understanding these architectural weaknesses is essential for designing resilient, secure satellite systems.

title: All-optical switching of nonlinear structured light in crystal-engineered van der Waals materials
headline: All-Optical Switching of Structured Light via Nonlinear Van der Waals Crystals
tldr: Researchers demonstrate ultrafast, all-optical control of orbital angular momentum modes using engineered van der Waals crystals. This approach enables compact, real-time switching of structured light without bulky free‑space optics.
significance: The technique paves the way for scalable, nanoscale photonic devices capable of dynamic OAM manipulation, critical for next‑generation optical communications and quantum information processing.

title: Insight into SRF cavity performance from simulations of Nb's surface oxide dissolution and diffusion
headline: Simulating Nb Oxide Dissolution to Predict SRF Cavity Performance in Accelerators
tldr: We simulate the dissolution and diffusion of niobium oxide layers in vacuum, linking the resulting oxygen distribution to the superconducting performance of SRF cavities. These insights help optimize surface preparation for particle accelerators.
significance: This work bridges the gap between surface chemistry and SRF cavity performance, guiding more efficient accelerator designs.

title: SAEVerbalizer: Generating Explanations for Sparse Autoencoder Features via Representation Verbalization
headline: SAEVerbalizer: Interpreting Sparse Autoencoder Features from LLM Representations for Transparent Insights
tldr: Sparse autoencoders extract many features from LLM embeddings, but explaining them usually relies on external observations, which can be superficial and computationally heavy. SAEVerbalizer offers a framework that verbalizes these features directly from representations, enabling efficient and deeper explanations.
significance: It provides a scalable, model-agnostic method to generate meaningful explanations for high-dimensional LLM features, improving transparency and trust.

title: Joint Communication-Control Strategy Optimization with Partially Nested Information Structures: The Linear-Quadratic Case
headline: Optimizing Joint Communication and Control in Multi-Agent Linear Systems with Partially Nested Information
tldr: The paper formalizes a joint communication–control strategy optimization problem for multi-agent linear systems with quadratic costs within the common-information-based framework. By focusing on partially nested information structures, it derives tractable, optimal solutions for the linear–quadratic case.
significance: It bridges decentralized control and communication design, enabling efficient coordination in multi-agent systems with limited information.

title: Non-uniqueness of Brakke flows starting from minimal surfaces with singularities
headline: Non-uniqueness of Brakke Flows from Singular Minimal Surfaces in Euclidean Space
tldr: We prove that minimal surfaces with singularities can generate multiple distinct Brakke flows. This demonstrates their dynamical instability.
significance: This result reveals that stationary varifolds need not uniquely determine their evolution, challenging assumptions in geometric measure theory.

title: The sensitivity of TESS to transiting planets in TOIs with close-in stellar companions
headline: TESS Transit Detection Sensitivity Affected by Close Stellar Companions in TOI Candidates
tldr: High-resolution imaging shows many TESS targets have close stellar companions that dilute transit signals. This study quantifies the impact on detecting small planets across 2052 TOIs, revealing reduced sensitivity in blended systems.
significance: Understanding companion-induced dilution is crucial for accurate planet occurrence rates from TESS.

title: DARTree: Speculative Diffusion Decoding with Autoregressive Draft Trees
headline: DARTree: Accelerating Autoregressive Models with Speculative Diffusion Draft Trees for Large Language Models
tldr: DARTree combines speculative decoding with diffusion-based draft trees, enabling parallel token block proposals while preserving causal conditioning. This approach reduces latency and improves throughput for autoregressive language models without sacrificing accuracy.
significance: By integrating diffusion drafters into speculative decoding, DARTree offers a scalable, lossless acceleration technique that can be applied to large language models in real-time applications.

title: Vero: Can AI Agents Build Formally Verified Software Repositories?
headline: Vero: AI Agents That Generate Verified Software Repositories for Trustworthy Development
tldr: AI agents can now produce both code and proofs of correctness, enabling formally verified software. Vero demonstrates this by building verified repositories, moving beyond function‑level benchmarks.
significance: This work bridges AI programming and formal verification, paving the way for trustworthy, automatically generated software.

title: Exponential quantum advantage for learning signals with a single qubit
headline: Single Qubit Quantum Sensor Cuts Measurement Needs Exponentially for Signal Learning
tldr: Researchers demonstrate that attaching a single controllable qubit to a conventional sensor can exponentially reduce the number of measurements needed to learn classical signals. This quantum advantage opens the door to more efficient data acquisition in practical experimental setups.
significance: This breakthrough shows that even minimal quantum resources can dramatically improve signal learning, making quantum sensing more accessible for real-world applications.

title: The data geometry of masking diffusion: Certified-optimal schedules via unmasking growth complexity
headline: Unmasking Growth Complexity: Optimal Masking Diffusion Schedules and KL Error Control
tldr: We introduce unmasking growth complexity (UGC), a path‑resolved metric that directly bounds KL discretization error in masking diffusion. This yields a unified analysis of Bernoulli‑subset and fixed‑cardinality unmasking schemes and certifies optimal sampling schedules.
significance: UGC provides a principled way to design and certify optimal masking diffusion schedules, improving discrete sampling efficiency in diffusion models.

title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology
headline: Dynamic Post-Operative Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology Using Intervention-Aware Models for Patients
tldr: We present a dynamic clinical world model that incorporates interventions and time-varying data to predict post-operative outcomes in cardiology. The model captures irregular trajectories of recovery, enabling more accurate risk assessment over time.
significance: This approach improves personalized post-operative care by providing continuous, intervention-aware outcome predictions, potentially reducing complications and readmissions.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Work with AI-Driven Feature Extraction and Predictive Analytics
tldr: Artificial intelligence is transforming geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction and classifying point clouds. These advances enable predictive analysis across the entire data pipeline, unlocking new applications for imagery, LiDAR, and spatial datasets.
significance: GeoAI's integration of AI and geospatial data accelerates insights, driving smarter decision-making in fields from urban planning to environmental monitoring.

title: ACMSIGSPATIAL-GEOAI 2025 - Conference Tagline
headline: Harnessing AI for Geospatial Insight: From Satellite to Society, Transforming Data and Decision Making
tldr: ACMSIGSPATIAL-GEOAI 2025 showcases breakthroughs in AI-driven geospatial analysis, emphasizing multimodal data integration and real-time decision support. Attendees will explore cutting-edge techniques from satellite imagery to LiDAR, unlocking new possibilities for societal impact.
significance: This conference accelerates the adoption of AI in geospatial science, enabling faster, more accurate solutions to global challenges.

title: Remote Sensing AI · GitHub
headline: Open-Source Remote Sensing AI Toolkit for Historical Maps and Satellite Imagery
tldr: Our GitHub repository hosts code and papers on geospatial AI, focusing on remote sensing data and historical maps. Researchers and students collaborate on projects since 2016, providing open-source tools and benchmarks.
significance: This repository accelerates research by offering reproducible, open-source AI solutions for analyzing remote sensing data across time and space.

title: Free GIS & Remote‑Sensing Toolkit | Gebeta Media
headline: Explore Free GIS & Remote‑Sensing Tools: Desktop, Cloud, Data, and ML Libraries
tldr: Discover a curated list of free and open‑source GIS and remote‑sensing resources, from desktop software to cloud platforms. The toolkit also includes open data sources and machine‑learning libraries for advanced spatial analysis.
significance: This guide empowers users to access powerful spatial tools without cost, accelerating research and application development.

title: TESSERA: An open-source satellite remote-sensing foundation model for ...
headline: TESSERA: Open-Source Satellite Foundation Model for Habitat Mapping and Conservation
tldr: TESSERA is an open-source foundation model that processes satellite imagery to support diverse environmental applications such as habitat mapping and carbon accounting. It provides a unified framework for researchers to develop and benchmark remote-sensing tools.
significance: By offering a freely available, high-performance model, TESSERA democratizes access to advanced satellite analytics for conservation science.

title: Experimental Quantum Key Distribution in an Indefinite Causal Order
headline: Quantum Key Distribution Achieves Indefinite Causal Order: A New BB84 Protocol Realized
tldr: Researchers implemented a BB84-like quantum cryptography protocol using processes with indefinite causal order, demonstrating that superposed operation sequences can serve as a quantum resource. This experiment opens avenues for more secure quantum communication and novel quantum information processing techniques.
significance: The work shows that indefinite causal order can be harnessed for practical quantum cryptography, potentially enhancing security and efficiency beyond conventional protocols.

title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
headline: AutoDesign: Optimizing Meta-Harness for Long-Horizon Agentic Multimodal Design Systems Innovation
tldr: AutoDesign proposes a meta-harness framework that treats multimodal source transformation as a long-horizon agentic process, enabling recursive self-improvement aligned with human design priors. By continuously learning from empirical exploration, the system surpasses static paradigms and delivers more adaptive, reusable design solutions.
significance: This framework advances autonomous design by embedding adaptive learning loops, promising smarter, more efficient multimodal content creation.

title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
headline: OmniScientist: Leveraging Foundation Models to Automate End-to-End Scientific Discovery Across Disciplines
tldr: OmniScientist uses foundation models to automate the full research cycle, from hypothesis generation to manuscript drafting. However, current systems lack direct access to raw evidence, limiting the depth of scientific insight.
significance: This work demonstrates how omni-modal AI can streamline research workflows, but highlights the need for evidence-aware reasoning.

title: Localised Horizons and Holographic Thermodynamics: Supercooling in the 1/D Expansion
headline: 1/D Expansion Reveals Supercooling Dynamics in Holographic Confinement Transitions
tldr: Using a 1/D expansion in higher-dimensional Einstein-scalar gravity, the study predicts the thermal confinement transition in non-conformal gauge theories. The analysis uncovers a supercooling regime, offering a new framework for understanding phase transitions in holographic models.
significance: This work provides a systematic, predictive tool for mapping confinement transitions in strongly coupled gauge theories, bridging holography and large-D techniques.

title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
headline: Reimagining Video Latent Spaces: V-RAE for Better Generation and Control
tldr: V-RAE proposes a new video autoencoder that optimizes latent space for generative tasks rather than pixel reconstruction. This leads to richer semantic organization and improved performance in video generation.
significance: By decoupling reconstruction from semantic fidelity, V-RAE enables more expressive generative models, advancing video synthesis capabilities.

title: Defensive Boosting for Online Probabilistic Forecasting
headline: Defensive Boosting Enhances Online Probabilistic Forecasting for Adaptive Adversaries
tldr: This paper introduces a defensive boosting framework that improves online probabilistic forecasting of binary outcomes against adaptive adversaries. It achieves two incomparable guarantees—Brier score competitiveness and span-based prediction quality—using efficient boosting techniques.
significance: It advances online learning by providing robust, high-performance probabilistic predictions in adversarial settings.

title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
headline: PlayWorld: Benchmarking Video World Models via Long-Horizon Agent Interaction for Realistic Evaluation
tldr: PlayWorld introduces a benchmark that uses agent players to evaluate video world models over long horizons, addressing the difficulty of fair comparison. The framework measures consistency, controllability, and task success in interactive settings.
significance: This work provides a standardized, human-like evaluation protocol that can accelerate the development of more reliable and controllable video world models.

title: Exponential Convex Calibration Dimension for the Multi-Label Jaccard Measure
headline: Calibrating Multi‑Label Jaccard: An Exponential Convex Dimension Analysis
tldr: This work establishes the nonsingularity of Jaccard‑based loss matrices and derives their affine dimension, providing a theoretical foundation for multi‑label evaluation. It also introduces a shifted‑loss formulation that preserves calibration properties while simplifying analysis.
significance: It offers a rigorous mathematical framework that improves the reliability of multi‑label segmentation metrics used in computer vision and remote sensing.

title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
headline: QuoteBench Reveals Hidden Command-Path Failures in LLM Coding Agents Evaluation
tldr: QuoteBench demonstrates that matched execution scores can mask failures introduced after LLM-generated Bash commands, by performing exact final-state validation across 56 one-shot tasks from 14 incident-derived families. The benchmark highlights the need for end-to-end validation to ensure reliable deployment of LLM coding agents.
significance: This work exposes a critical blind spot in current LLM evaluation practices, urging the community to adopt stricter, state-based validation for safer automation.

title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
headline: Alaya-EVOKE: Scaling Interactive World Models for Persistent Memory and Low-Latency Interaction
tldr: Alaya‑EVOKE introduces a framework that balances long‑horizon generation with real‑time responsiveness by optimizing denoiser context and key‑value cache usage. The approach enables interactive world models to maintain persistent memory without sacrificing latency, paving the way for more immersive AI experiences.
significance: This work addresses a core bottleneck in deploying large foundation models for real‑time, memory‑intensive applications, offering a scalable solution that could transform interactive AI systems.

title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
headline: Curated Elementary Curriculum for Language Model Training
tldr: We introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, an 88B-token corpus of U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding advanced concepts to control knowledge exposure. This enables systematic study of how language models acquire knowledge and skills.
significance: It offers a controlled benchmark for probing and improving LLM learning processes.

title: Skew Hives, Skew Skeps, Skew Schur Log-Concavity
headline: Skew Hives and Skew Skeps: A Unified Approach to Schur Log-Concavity
tldr: We introduce skew hive and skew skep models that generalize both hives and skeps, and use them to prove a new skew Schur log-concavity theorem extending the Lam–Postnikov–Pylyavskyy result.
significance: This work unifies two combinatorial frameworks and establishes a broad log-concavity property for skew Schur functions, advancing our understanding of symmetric function theory.

title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
headline: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for Generating Editable 3D Parts in a Single Pass
tldr: SCULPT introduces a subtractive approach that integrates part-awareness directly into the 3D generation loop, eliminating the need for post-hoc segmentation. The method produces coherent, editable parts that can be reused or animated, improving workflow efficiency for designers.
significance: By embedding part structure during generation, SCULPT streamlines the creation of modular 3D assets, reducing time and computational overhead compared to segmentation-based pipelines.

title: Emergent heavy fermion and superconductivity near Mott transition in twisted bilayer graphene
headline: Heavy-Fermion Behavior and Superconductivity Near Mott Transition in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
tldr: We demonstrate that near a bandwidth‑tuned Mott transition in twisted bilayer graphene, the Fermi velocity and quasiparticle residue vanish, revealing heavy‑fermion physics. This emergent framework predicts superconductivity at integer fillings without invoking remote bands.
significance: It provides a unified heavy‑fermion description of correlated states in twisted bilayer graphene, linking Mott physics to superconductivity.

title: Near optimal three-fold additive energy bound for points on convex curves
headline: Three-Fold Additive Energy Bound for Convex Curve Points Achieves Near-Optimal Growth
tldr: The authors prove that the three-fold additive energy of points on a strictly convex curve is bounded by |X|^{3+ε}. This leads to improved lower bounds for sumsets of convex sequences, namely |A−A|≫|A|^{5/3−ε} and |A+A|≫|A|^{8/5−ε}.
significance: These results sharpen our understanding of additive combinatorics on convex sets, approaching the conjectured optimal exponent.

title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
headline: Agentic Video Auto-Encoder Enables Cinematic Video Learning for AI Agents
tldr: The AVA-Encoder introduces a structured video representation that captures film-level semantics, allowing agents to reason and manipulate video content directly. It combines auto-encoding with agentic objectives, bridging the gap between cinematic data and agentic reasoning.
significance: It provides the first agent-native video representation that supports high-level cinematic reasoning and manipulation.

title: The Role Specialization Model (RSM): Coordinating LLM-Based Tools in Agentic Software Development - An Exploratory Case Study
headline: Coordinating LLM Tools in Agentic Software Development: The Role Specialization Model
tldr: This study explores how three LLM-based tools—Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and Q—can be coordinated using the Role Specialization Model to support autonomous software development. The findings suggest that specialized roles improve efficiency and human oversight in Agentic SE 3.0.
significance: By demonstrating a practical coordination framework, the paper advances the feasibility of fully autonomous software engineering under human supervision.

title: DreamFly: Causal Memory and Receding-Horizon Diffusion Planning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
headline: DreamFly: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Causal Memory and Diffusion Planning
tldr: DreamFly introduces a causal memory module and a receding-horizon diffusion planner to improve aerial vision-language navigation under partial observability. By integrating long-term visual context and planning over future actions, the system outperforms existing models on aerial VLN benchmarks.
significance: This work bridges the gap between vision-language navigation and aerial robotics, enabling more reliable navigation in complex, partially observable environments.

title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
headline: Test-Time Transfer: Strong Models Build Weak Ones on the Fly
tldr: The authors show that a strong model can generate test-time harnesses to steer a weaker model during inference. This approach transfers capabilities without updating parameters, offering a new paradigm for model distillation.
significance: It introduces a novel test-time distillation paradigm that could reduce the need for costly retraining of smaller models.

title: Constructing Dynamic Master Logic Models as Knowledge Graphs for Complex System Diagnostics Using Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
headline: Automating Dynamic Master Logic Models with Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Complex System Diagnostics
tldr: This paper introduces a framework that automatically builds Dynamic Master Logic models—hierarchical knowledge graphs linking objectives to system components—using retrieval-augmented large language models. The approach reduces reliance on expert interpretation, enabling scalable diagnostics for complex engineered systems.
significance: By automating DML construction, the method accelerates system understanding and fault diagnosis, paving the way for more efficient maintenance of intricate infrastructures.

title: A Framework for Designing Reward Functions: From Objectives to Features to Human-Aligned Reward Functions
headline: Framework for Human‑Aligned Reward Functions from Natural‑Language Objectives and Iterative Design
tldr: We propose a three‑step process that turns a natural‑language task description into a linear reward function aligned with human preferences. The method distills objectives, measures outcomes, and iteratively refines the reward to match desired behavior.
significance: This framework democratizes reward engineering, enabling non‑experts to create robust, preference‑aligned policies for complex AI systems.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Breakthroughs: From Real-Time Flood Detection to Urban Planning AI
tldr: In 2025, GeoAI harnesses satellite imagery and LLMs to deliver real-time flood alerts and autonomous urban planning. These advances accelerate climate resilience and smart city development worldwide.
significance: These innovations enable faster, data-driven responses to environmental crises and urban growth.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Charting the Future of Geospatial AI: From Integration to Innovation
tldr: Geospatial AI blends spatial science with machine learning, rapidly evolving into a leading research frontier. This paper reviews recent progress and outlines future directions for the field.
significance: Understanding GeoAI's trajectory is essential for leveraging spatial data to address global challenges.

title: Top 5 Geospatial AI Trends to Watch in 2025 - arizton.com
headline: Top 5 GeoAI Trends to Watch in 2025: From Urban Planning to Agriculture
tldr: GeoAI blends GIS and AI to unlock insights across sectors. In 2025, five key trends—urban AI, crop monitoring, flood detection, change detection, and real-time analytics—will shape the industry.
significance: These trends will drive smarter decision-making and operational efficiency across urban, agricultural, and environmental domains.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insights: AI Meets Satellite Data for Smarter Decision-Making
tldr: Artificial intelligence is transforming the geospatial industry by combining data, sensors, and AI-driven analysis. This shift, known as GeoAI, promises more accurate and actionable insights for organizations worldwide.
significance: GeoAI is poised to redefine how organizations capture and interpret spatial information, unlocking new levels of efficiency and insight.
